messages.content: Hello, Ayush. How can I help you today?
Tell me everything you know about me.

Ayush, you’re a second‑year BCA student who prefers English, takes courses in machine learning, database management systems and AI, and are working on a final‑year B.Tech project called JARVIS. You like short answers, and your typical habits are: after a UI wait you often play something on YouTube; after listening to Arijit Singh you tend to pause; after Talwinder music you usually open the settings page, which then leads to YouTube again. You’ve asked me to open apps and check updates before.
